context_truths: Aleksandra Velickovic is Content Manager at Search Atlas / LinkGraph, reporting to Justin Rondeau (Head of Growth).
Content team: Milena, Emanuel, Andresa, Mateus, James — plus collaboration with the broader marketing team.
Q2 2026 strategy: quality over volume, landing pages as primary content type, improved intent targeting.
Q2 2026 goal was 360 weighted content points. Final close: 400.69 pts (+11.3% above goal).
Scoring model: 4k-word article = 1pt, landing page = 3pt, case study = 3pt, everything else (brief/email/news/research/LP edit/guest post) = 1pt.
Q3 2026 targets: 420 weighted pts (~33/wk), 5 SA articles/week, LLM visibility recovered to 30%+ across 3+ platforms, organic traffic recovered to 16,900 clicks/28d.
LLM visibility collapsed from 50.8% to 10% between Q2 start and now (Jun 2026). Only ChatGPT (40%) and Copilot (20%) show any visibility; Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are all at 0%.
Organic clicks are down ~17% vs the Q2 peak (16,900 → ~13,978 over 28 days), despite average position improving from 33.4 to 28.2 — the gap is CTR, likely from AI Mode click displacement.
18 pages are in 3-period content decay as of June 2026.
Top quick-win keyword: 'google ai mode' at ~39K impressions/28d, average position 6.2, only 8 clicks — a clear CTR/title-tag opportunity.
AI CMO batch (9 articles) published mid-June 2026 as part of the 'agentic marketing' positioning push.
ContentGenius output quality lags the Claude Code MCP workflow; feedback was delivered to Jason (product) as a live Q3 priority.
Search Atlas rebrand positioning (June 2026): 'The growth engine that runs your marketing while you sleep' — never call it a 'tool', avoid antithesis framing ('not X, it's Y').
